lines.trans: Juliette, I am with Jean-Denis Gillieres.
He wants to see you right away.
No, I beg you, not him!
I do not want to see him.
He is so tiresome!
He does not understand the word no.
Understood, I am taking care of it.
Juliette is truly sorry, sir.
She is rehearsing her important speech.
I adore intelligent women!
She is preparing her first film.
Let us have lunch on my boat on Monday.
It will be calm and very pleasant.
I can help with the financing.
Monday is perfect for us!

examples.text: Je suis sérieuse. J'ai toujours adoré le cinéma.
examples.trans: I'm serious. I've always loved films.

examples.text: Est-ce que Rebecca Vialle est dans mon agenda aujourd'hui?
examples.trans: Is Rebecca Vialle in my diary today?

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis').

examples.text: Ce sera calme et très agréable.
examples.trans: It will be calm and very pleasant.

examples.text: Et demain, tu déjeunes avec Audiard.
examples.trans: And tomorrow you're having lunch with Audiard.

examples.text: Mais trois mois de tournage, sur un bateau, en pleine mer!
examples.trans: But three months of shooting, on a boat, out at sea!

examples.text: Reste calme, Julie. Pense à ta carrière.
examples.trans: Stay calm, Julie. Think of your career.

meanings.note: une rue calme = a quiet street
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Je comprends. C'est un coup dur.
examples.trans: I understand. It's a real blow.

meanings.note: Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Prefix 'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'. Core French verb meaning 'to understand'.

examples.text: Tu connais beaucoup de monde dans le cinéma. Tu pourrais m'aider.
examples.trans: You know lots of people in film. You could help me.

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

for masculine nouns, and in impersonal phrases: il y a
Prefix 'im-' marks negation ('un-, im-') or inward motion.
Prefix 'in-'/'im-' marks negation ('un-, in-') or inward motion.

examples.trans: Gabriel! I'm at my horse-riding lesson.

First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to note, write down'.

examples.text: Notez tout ce que je dis.
Notez tout: des fontaines et de la musique.
Je dois m'occuper de la musique. Profite de l'ambiance.
examples.trans: I have to take care of the music. Enjoy the atmosphere.

occuper.gloss: to occupy; to take care of

meanings.en: s'occuper de = to take care of, to deal with
pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
C'est comme un rêve pour moi.
examples.trans: It's like a dream for me.

meanings.note: before an infinitive: pour faire plaisir

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

examples.text: Tes premières vacances en huit ans!
examples.trans: Your first holiday in eight years!

examples.text: Le premier jour, tu as vu Mathias avant Andréa. Donc tu le connais!
examples.trans: On the first day, you saw Mathias before Andréa. So you know him!

meanings.note: goes before the noun: les premières vacances

examples.text: Écoutez, j'ai quinze chevaux à préparer.
examples.trans: Listen, I have fifteen horses to get ready.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Core French verb meaning 'to prepare, to make'.

examples.text: Je répète un rôle. Va jouer dans ta chambre.
examples.trans: I'm rehearsing a part. Go and play in your room.

meanings.en: to rehearse, to practise (a role, a play)
meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to rehearse; to repeat'.

examples.text: Oui, trois cent mille. Je parle de ses vingt ans de carrière.
examples.trans: Yes, three hundred thousand. I'm talking about his twenty years of career.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner
